What's actually wrong (short): PostgreSQL refused the connection because pg_hba.conf has no matching rule allowing the client host 10.2.4.19 to connect as user "svc" to the "app" database on db-prod-2. That rejection happens before the server even checks the password in the env dump.

One-liner for the team (pasteable):
"Root cause: Postgres on db-prod-2 is rejecting connections from 10.2.4.19 — no pg_hba.conf rule for svc -> app; add a host line (e.g. host app svc 10.2.4.19/32 scram-sha-256 or md5 as appropriate) and reload Postgres (pg_reload_conf()) to restore connectivity."
